correctness.rationale: The complete one/two-factor vector determines the first and last letter by unigram-minus-indegree/outdegree identities. Singleton vertices have forced incident directed paths; the profile determines ordered outer paths and the unordered set of distinct nonempty delimiter returns. Interleaving k distinguishable returns with r-1-k identical empty returns gives (r-1)!/(r-1-k)! realizations. The quotient is bijective to partitions of s+1 labeled atoms into k+1 unordered nonempty ordered lists, counted by Lah numbers. Sharp saturation and dominant-fiber probability follow by exact factorial counting. Actual direct enumeration passed 43 cases (total length <=10), constructive list partition comparison passed 56 cases, but the unlimited quantifiers rest on the proof.
